set.body: For each scenario record raw and executable LOC, required domain concepts, setup/install friction, public construction ceremony, error locality, output labeling, leakage resistance, identity visibility, extensibility, and debugging notes. Summarize findings without collapsing elegance into one fake score. Convert confirmed ScalaFIM defects or missing intended capabilities into linked tickets; keep intentional scope exclusions explicit.
set.title: C7: audit ergonomics, LOC, pain points, and architecture consequences
